claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_bonus_action_unarmed_strike
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Bonus Unarmed Strike grants a specific bonus action attack (unarmed only), not a full extra Action. grant_extra_action covers an additional full action and cannot express 'make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action' without overstating the grant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: override_unarmed_damage_die
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Martial Arts Die replaces the damage die of Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons with a class-level-scaled die (1d6→d8→d10→d12). This is a die substitution on the attack resolution, not a fixed damage instance (damage atom) and not a numeric additive rider (modify_damage_numeric). natural_weapons is spell-scoped and also changes damage type. No v4 atom covers 'replace the damage die of unarmed/melee attacks with a specific scaled die'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can roll 1d6 in place of the normal damage of your Unarmed Strike or Monk weapons. This die changes as you gain Monk levels, as shown in the Martial Arts column of the Monk Features table.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: substitute_ability_modifier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Dexterous Attacks lets the monk use Dex modifier instead of Str modifier for attack and damage rolls with unarmed strikes and monk weapons, and for Grapple/Shove save DCs. modify_roll_numeric adds a delta to rolls; it cannot model 'use X mod in place of Y mod' because the swap is conditional on which is higher and applies to the base modifier, not as an addendum.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons. In addition, when you use the Grapple or Shove option of your Unarmed Strike, you can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to determine the save DC.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.not_wielding_shield
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The condition gate requires 'not wielding a Shield'. The existing not_wearing_armor predicate covers armor categories (light/medium/heavy) but Shield is a separate equipment slot not covered by any predicate variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the following benefits while you are unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons and you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.unarmed_or_monk_weapons_only
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The condition gate requires 'unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons (simple melee or light martial melee)'. The existing wielding_weapon predicate uses coarse weapon kinds (ranged/melee_two_handed/melee_one_handed/two_weapons) and cannot express 'holding no weapon or holding only from a filtered weapon subset'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the following benefits while you are unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons and you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield.
